newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PSE closes week on positive, but muted note.
newsitem.headline: Czech PSE closes week on positive, but muted note.

text.p: The Prague Stock Exchange closed the week on a positive note, though dealers were muted in their praise for the beleaguered bourse.
Komercni Banka and CEZ rallied while most other blue chips were quiet as the PX50 index edged up 1.1 points to 510.4.
Overall, 159 issues rose, 152 lost ground and 71 were unchanged.

"We've seen Komercni up and down a lot lately, and I think this is due more to accounting moves by investment funds than any fundamental volatility in the issue," said one local trader. "I suspect the CEZ move is similar."
Total volume was modest at 745,878 shares on turnover of 693 million crowns.

Several broader issues also posted strongest gains including glass fibre maker Vertex, up 184 crowns to 3,870, computer network PVT, up 156 crowns to 3,400, ceramics maker Chlumcanske, up 155 crowns to 3,255, and insurere Ceska Pojistovna, up 130 to 3,200.
